Good. We get away from it all for a week.
Yes. It is an unforgettable trip.

lessons.wordTask: What does Emma do at night?

transferCheck.source: On Tuesday, Emma visits her teacher, Ms. Green. Emma says, 'I can use holiday English in a new situation. I go on holiday by a lake with my mother.' Ms. Green says, 'Good. What do you do at night?' Emma says, 'We sleep under the stars. The tide comes in at night.' Ms. Green says, 'Very good. Do you see the birds?' Emma says, 'Yes. I use binoculars to see the birds. We escape from the city.' Ms. Green says, 'Good. You use holiday English well.'
transferCheck.dictation: We sleep under the stars tonight.
transferCheck.answer: 1. Emma visits her teacher, Ms. Green. She talks about a holiday by a lake with her mother. 2. Emma's first job is to say she can use holiday English in a new situation. 3.
